name: T. Whiteshell
description:
This ancient Windurstian currency,
valuing 1 mumu, dates back to C.E.
294. The engraving commemorates the
joining of the Tarutaru tribes and the
establishment of the Federation.

valuing 100 mumus, dates back to C.E.
373. The engraving commemorates the
warlord Lungo-Nango's invasion of
Elvaan occupied Southern Quon.

name: Red Cryptex
description:
A red stone used by the Orcs to
deliver orders. The red color signifies
"Ronfaure," and the number of nails
imbedded in its surface signifies
"Attack."

name: Dst. Engraving
description:
A sheet of darksteel used by the
Quadav to deliver orders. Upon it is a
map of Gustaberg with arrows
indicating an invasion route.

name: 7-Knot Quipu
description:
A knotted rope used by the Yagudo to
deliver orders. The type of knot
signifies the order (attack), while the
number of knots signifies the location
(Sarutabaruta).

name: Galka Fang Sack
description:

thieves to relay messages. It is
believed that the type of fang (Galka)
represents the place of meeting
(Zulkheim).

This fragrant leaf is often used as
a spice.

This coeurl hide is in excellent
condition.

name: Cactuar Root
description:
Over thousands of years of evolution,
the roots of the cactuar have
developed into "legs" capable of
carrying the plantoids long distances.

name: Dire Candle
description:
This item first appeared long ago in a
Hume epic poem. It is written that the
emperor who lights this candle is
plagued with misfortune.

name: Bloody Candle
description:
This item first appeared long ago in a
Hume epic poem. It is written that the
empress who lights this candle has the
life essence slowly drained from her.

name: Tome of Whispers
description:
Used in Elvaan rituals, this forbidden
parchment lists worldly sins.
However, it is rumored that the souls
of those who read it are damned
for eternity.

name: Tome of Moans
description:
Used in Elvaan rituals, this forbidden
astrological document is said to
reveal the future. However, it is
rumored that the souls of those
who read it are damned for eternity.

name: Snickering Skull
description:
A Tarutaru lullaby warns that bad
children who forget their chores will
be visited by the snickering skull,
and those who have heard the skull's
snickering cannot stop laughing
themselves.

name: Sniffling Skull
description:
A Tarutaru lullaby warns that bad
children who do not go to bed
early will be visited by the sniffling
skull, and those who have heard
the skull's sniffling cannot stop crying
themselves.

name: Yhoator Flea
description:
Mithran urban myth states that if
bitten by the legendary Yhoator flea,
one's entire body will itch for days.

name: Rusty Tail Cutter
description:
Galkan ghost stories tell grim tales of
those who had the misfortune to come
across these dreaded cutters.
Tails lopped off by the tool are said
to never grow back...

mannequin.

mannequin.

A curse has been placed upon the

from wearing it.

name: Antlion Jaw
description: A giant antlion jaw.

name: Flytrap Leaf
description:
Members of the flytrap family use
these large, broad leaves to hover
above the ground.

name: Uragnite Shell
description:
This hard shell protects the uragnite
from predators.

name: Hippogryph Fthr.
description:
This feather grows on the head of a
hippogryph.

name: Taurus Horn
description:
This dark horn is bent into an almost
perfect half-circle.

name: Taurus Wing
description:
The blood that poured from the wound
where the wing was removed has begun
to coagulate...

name: Bugard Tusk
description: The overdeveloped canine of a bugard.

name: Eft Skin
description:
Thousands of tiny scales make up this
brilliantly sparkling skin.

name: Bugbear Mask
description:
A leather mask that filters out toxic
gasses. Due to its odd shape, only
bugbears can wear it.

name: Moblin Helm
description:
A simple brass helm. Due to its odd
shape, only Moblins can wear it.

name: Avatar Blood
description:
This blood appears to have
come from a terrestrial avatar.
It glows faintly in the dark.

name: Arm. Arrowhd.
description: The striking tips of Bodkin arrows.

name: Buffalo Hide
description: The prickly hide of a buffalo.

name: Buffalo Leather
description: Thick and durable buffalo leather.

name: Cluster Ash
description: The burnt remains of a cluster.

name: Moblin Armor
description:
Armor made of cloth and leather.
Due to its odd shape, only Moblins
can wear it.

name: Moblin Mail
description:
Simple brass armor. Due to its odd
shape, only Moblins can wear it.

name: Clot Plasma
description:
A miniature plasmoid sample taken from
a clot species of the slime family. It
is perfectly edible, and quite delicious,
once detoxified.

name: Rhodonite

name: Paktong Ingot

name: Moblinweave

Light, sturdy, fire-resistant cloth

name: Bugard Leather

Bugard leather is famous for being
highly resistant to the elements.

name: Moblin Mask

A leather mask that filters out dust
and smoke. Due to its odd shape, only
Moblins can wear it.

name: Corse Robe

The velvet robe of a corse. A
curse has been placed upon the
clothing, preventing anything living
from wearing it.

name: Bugard Skin
description: The bumpy skin of a bugard.

Deep red gems are embedded
within this rock.

This ore contains the metal
kopparnickel.

name: Moblin Thread
description:
Thread spun from an artificial fiber
developed by the Moblins.

name: Rice Vinegar
description:
A traditional Eastern vinegar made by
fermenting rice.

name: Demon Pen
description:
This magical pen is made from the
finger of a Demon. When placed on
a piece of parchment, it will
write one's diary for him.

name: Igneous Rock
description: This rock is formed when magma cools.

name: Leather Pouch
description: A small bag made from sheep leather.

name: Brass Tank
description:
This tank made from brass sheets is
mainly used to store liquids.

name: Bundling Twine
description:
This twine is used by members
of the Carpenters' Guild to
bundle logs together.

name: Sealion Crest Key
description:
A sealion is engraved into the handle
of this brass key.

name: Coral Crest Key
description:
A branch of coral is engraved into the
handle of this brass key.

name: Bronze Key
description: A simple key forged from bronze.

name: Misareaux Garlic
description:
This variety of garlic, known for
its pungent odor and high level of
nutrition, is only found on the
Tavnazian Archipelago.

name: Ctdl. Tapestry
description:
Said to have been used by a
former saint, this tapestry has
been recognized by the San d'Orian
Cathedral as an authentic relic.

name: Arnica Root
description:
When ground into a powder and
served with hot water, the
root of the arnica has the
ability to cure various ailments.

name: Eastern Gem
description:
These flat, round jade stones are
treasured in lands to the Far East.

name: Copper Key
description: A tiny key made of pure copper.

name: Chameleon Dia.
description:
This rare diamond changes color
depending on the surrounding air
temperature.

name: Cluster Core
description: The molten center of a cluster.

name: Clean Snap Rod
description:
This fastwater fishing rod has been
snapped perfectly in two--almost
too perfectly.

name: Hoary Bomb Ash
description: The burnt remains of an ancient bomb.

name: Sprt. Orichalcum

Enhanced by the power of anima,
the hardness of this orichalcum
ingot has more than doubled.

name: Bwtch. Ash Lbr.
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this ash has the ability to break
powerful curses.

name: Exor. Oak Lbr.

Enhanced by the power of anima,
this oak has the ability to reflect
magic.

name: Ether. Oak Lbr.
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this oak has the ability to teleport.

name: Indurated Gold

Enhanced by the power of anima,
this gold's hardness has more than
doubled.

name: Neutralizing Slv.
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this silver has the ability to
neutralize even the strongest of
poisons.

name: Frgd. Orichalcum

Enhanced by the power of anima, the
temperature of this orichalcum ingot
has been pushed well below freezing.

name: Aqueous Ocl.
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this orichalcum has the power to
call forth the spirits of water.

name: Rogue's Silver
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this silver shines brighter than
most precious metals.

name: Bewitched Gold
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this gold has the ability to break
powerful curses.

name: H.Q. Bugard Skin
description:
This bugard skin is in excellent
condition.

name: Light Steel
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this steel weighs half that of a
normal ingot.

name: Treasury Gold
description:
The Kingdom of San d'Oria stores
these ingots in the heavily guarded
royal treasury. The mark of the griffon
is imbedded in the center of each bar.

name: Attohwa Ginseng
description:
This medicinal root only grows in
the arid soil of the Attohwa
Chasm. Its rarity makes it quite
expensive.

name: Gold Key
description: An elaborately designed solid gold key.

name: Warding Oil
description:
Members of the Quadav patrol use this
pungent oil in their lamps. It is said
that the strong odor the oil emits
when lit repels even the most terrible
of beasts.

name: Soiled Letter
description:
This grimy letter has been sealed
with red wax.

This feather grows on the tail of
a hippogryph.

name: Giant Scale
description:
This faintly glowing scale is thought
to have been taken from the body of
a colossal wyrm.

name: Carmine Chip
description:
This translucent carmine chip is shaped
like a tiny hexagon. A strange light
is emitted from its sparkling center.

name: Cyan Chip
description:
This translucent cyan chip is shaped
like a tiny hexagon. A strange light
is emitted from its sparkling center.

name: Gray Chip
description:
This translucent gray chip is shaped
like a tiny hexagon. A strange light
is emitted from its sparkling center.

name: Habaneros
description:
Molten hot peppers famous for being
more "stimulating" than the renowned
blazing peppers.

name: Magicked Steel
description:
This special steel has been forged with
a magical flame.

name: Spruce Lumber
description: Processed spruce lumber.

name: Extra-Fine File
description:
It is said Demons use these files to
sharpen their horns and claws.

name: Scarlet Linen
description:
Cloth woven from linen
and bloodthread.

name: Bloodthread
description:
This scarlet thread is produced by a
variety of diremite. Much like a
spider's web, it is extremely light,
but unbelievably strong.

name: Fine Linen Cloth
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this linen is twice as thin as that
of a normal square.

name: Smooth Velvet
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this velvet is extremely soft and
smooth.

name: Kunwu Ore
description:
This ore contains traces of the metal
kunwu iron.

name: Kunwu Iron
description:
A chunk of kunwu iron, smelted using
a traditional Far Eastern method.

name: Kunwu Sheet
description: Kunwu iron forged into a sheet.

name: Nyumomo Doll
description:
The main character from the
ridiculously popular "Nyumomo, the
Twirling Taru" comics. There is not
a girl in Jeuno who has not begged
her father to buy her one of these
dolls.

name: Eastern Paper
description:
This high-quality paper has been made
with advanced methods known only
to those living in the Eastern empire.

name: Counterfeit Gil
description:
It is rumored the Goblins make these
replicas of real gil. However, because
they cannot duplicate the magic
imprint cast by the Vana'diel Treasury,
most shopkeeps can easily spot one.

name: Naphille Pochette
description:
Naphille is known around Jeuno for
being on the cutting edge of fashion
trends. Anyone who's who in the duchy
can be seen carrying one of her
outrageously expensive pochettes.

name: Fernan's Diaries
description:
This biography portrays a day in the
life of Jeuno's most popular actor,
Fernan. From witty quotes to
true-to-life drawings, there is enough
material in this book to make any fan
drool.

name: Molybden. Ingot
description: An ingot of smelted molybdenum ore.

name: Cashmere Wool
description:
This lustrous wool is found on a
rare variety of sheep bred only in Near
Eastern nations.

name: Cashmere Thrd.
description: Thread spun from cashmere wool.

name: Cashmere Cloth
description:
Luxurious cloth woven from the
highest quality cashmere thread.
It retains heat better than any of
the more common wools.

name: Vivified Coral
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this coral has begun to grow again.

name: Smth. Btl. Jaw
description:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
this beetle jaw creates almost no
friction.

name: Photoanima
description:
This fully materialized quasispirit
emits the auras of all eight elements.

name: M-bugard Tusk
description: The twisted tusk of a megalobugard.

name: Harajnite Shell
description:
This hard shell protects the harajnite
from predators.

name: Teal Memosphere
description:
The crystallized remains of one of
the Empty. It emits a soft blue glow.

name: Beryl Memosphere
description:
The crystallized remains of one of
the Empty. It emits a soft green glow.

name: Indigo Memosphere
description:
The crystallized remains of one of
the Empty. It emits a soft indigo glow.

name: White Memosphere
description:
The crystallized remains of one of
the Empty. It emits a soft white glow.

name: Soulflayer Robe
description:
A long silk robe once worn by a
soulflayer.
Cannot be equipped by people.

name: Snow Lily
description:
This rare type of high-altitude lily
blooms even in the harshest of
conditions.

name: Egret Fishing Rod
description:
The Fishermen's Guild no longer
carries this high-quality fishing
rod. Unfortunately, this one is broken.

name: Gar. Teak Lumber
description:
A processed piece of lumber made from
a rare tree only found on the southern
island of Garhada.

name: Ordrynite
description:
This legendary ore is rumored to
harbor an unimaginable amount of
energy. When held up to the light,
it glows brightly.

name: Moblin Hotrok
description:
When rubbed, this smooth stone
becomes unbearably hot. Essential
for cooking and heating in the areas
of Movalpolos where the use of
flammable materials is restricted.

name: Polar Flowerpot
description:
This pot is specially designed to slow
the growth of the polar fir.

name: Knightsbells
description:
The knights of early San d'Oria used
to attach these tiny bells to their
chocobo saddles.

name: Rimed Sapling
description:
This tiny tree has been covered in a
beautiful layer of ice.

name: Ice Bauble
description: Ice carved into a perfect sphere.

name: Blue Bandeau
description: A sparkling blue band of velvet.

name: Khue Pie
description:
A meat pie made by the world-famous
ranger Khue Ronchab. While delicious
when hot, its flavor is comparable to
a sweaty mocassin when cool.

name: Mehiruru Pop
description:
A tasty frozen snack invented by the
black mage Mehiruru. Unfortunately, it
melts at a very low temperature.

name: Jade Bauble
description: Jade carved into a perfect sphere.

name: Shakudo Ingot
description:
This variety of blood-red copper is
found in the Far East.

name: Balloon Cloth
description:
This sturdy variety of cotton cloth
was once used in Bastok when building
hot-air balloons.

name: Iolite

name: H.Q. Eft Skin

Made from a blend of wool and cotton,

smooth and lustrous.

name: Habu Skin

This molt comes from the deadly habu
snake found in the Far East.

name: Tiger Eye

A worn square of leather made from

skin of a variety of deer found in

Bleached white, this durable cloth

Far West.

name: Dragon Bone

name: Super Cermet

Alchemy is used to synthesize these
chunks of extra-super-hard material.

name: Dark Scales

These scales are fashioned from pure
darksteel.

name: Red Gravel

These marble-sized reddish-brown
rocks crumble quite easily.

name: Brimsand

A powerful type of firesand enhanced

name: Spaghetti

Long, thick strands of pasta made

Jakaka gave you this bag and told
you to travel to the top of Parradamo
Tor. Are you supposed to collect
something...?

Jakaka's flaxen pouch is filled with
tiny pumice pebbles gathered from the
top of Parradamo Tor.

name: Cotton Pouch

Zebada gave you this bag to collect

Zebada's cotton pouch is filled with

them, the clogs cannot be equipped.

name: Cursed Clogs -1
description:
These luxurious clogs have been
decorated with the finest platinum silk.
However, due to a terrible curse that
has been placed upon them, the clogs
cannot be equipped.

name: Minium
description: A variety of powdered red lead.

name: F. Glass Sheet
description:
A high quality sheet of extremely
pliable glass.

name: Rusty Medal
description:
An old Republican Iron Medal.
The inscription on the back reads:
"863 C.E. Xarcabard."

name: Frayed Arrow
description:
A red string has been wrapped
around the shaft of this worn arrow.

name: Colorful Hair
description:
This tuft consists of hair
of several colors and textures.

name: Carbon Dioxide
description:
Colorless and odorless
carbon dioxide gas.

name: Rubber Cap
description:
This inner cap is made of an
extremely resilient rubber.

name: Rubber Harness
description:
This inner harness is made of an
extremely resilient rubber.

name: Rubber Gloves
description:
These inner gloves are made of an
extremely resilient rubber.

name: Rubber Chausses
description:
These inner chausses are made of an
extremely resilient rubber.

name: Rubber Soles
description:
These inner soles are made of an
extremely resilient rubber.

name: Nethereye Chain
description:
Chain made from metal
forged in the Underworld.

name: Netherfield Chain
description:
Chain made from metal
forged in the Underworld.

name: Netherspirit Chain
description:
Chain made from metal
forged in the Underworld.

name: Nethercant Chain
description:
Chain made from metal
forged in the Underworld.

name: Netherpact Chain
description:
Chain made from metal
forged in the Underworld.

name: Kaolin
description:
High quality clay
used in making ceramics.

name: Platinum Silk
description:
Smooth silk wrapped around
a fine thread of pure platinum.

name: Soul Plate
description:
The image of a monster has been
superimposed on this glass plate.

name: Soul Reflector
description:
Reflects the image imposed on a
soul plate, calling forth the recorded
monster.

name: Chocobet Ticket
description:
This CRA-issued ticket is used for
selecting the order in which chocobos
will place in races. Winning tickets
should be taken to the nearest CRA
outlet.

name: Gauger Plate
description: The fearsome image of a fiend's soul has been burned on this plate with a Soulgauger SGR-1.

name: Comp. Certificate
description:
A document distributed certifying
the participation of your chocobo
in a CRA-sanctioned race. Necessary
for collecting any reward money.

name: Chocotrain: STR
description:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo strength conditioning.

name: Chocotrain: END
description:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo endurance conditioning.

name: Chocotrain: DSC
description:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo discernment conditioning.

name: Chocotrain: RCP
description:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo receptivity conditioning.

name: Chocobuck Slip
description:
Exchange this ticket for chocobucks at
any VCS Chocobuck Exchange Depot.

name: M. Camp Entry
description:
A form permitting entry to a top-
secret mercenary training camp.
The Salaheem's Sentinels logo
can be seen when held to a light.

name: Alexandrite
description:
A rare and precious gem, the color of
which shifts between various hues of
green and red depending on the light.

name: W. Areuhat
description:
A full-color transcription of the
famous Near Eastern literary classic.
Tells the story of a bold young
swordswoman and her adventures while
seeking out the wyrms of Vana'diel.

name: Forbidden Key
description: A key from a forgotten time, plucked from a dark chasm of time and space.

name: Leujaoam Log
description:
A blank Assault log given to you by
Paparoon. It contains enough room for
even the most ambitious of Leujaoam
Sanctum exploits to be committed to
page in scrupulous detail.

name: Mamool Ja Journal
description:
A blank Assault journal given to you
by Paparoon. It contains enough room
for even the most ambitious of Mamool
Ja Training Grounds exploits to be
committed to page in scrupulous detail.

name: Lebros Chronicle
description:
A blank Assault chronicle given to you
by Paparoon. It contains enough room
for even the most ambitious of Lebros
Cavern exploits to be committed to
page in scrupulous detail.

name: Periqia Diary
description:
A blank Assault diary given to you by
Paparoon. It contains enough room for
even the most ambitious of Periqia
exploits to be committed to page in
scrupulous detail.

name: Ilrusi Ledger
description:
A blank Assault ledger given to you by
Paparoon. It contains enough room for
even the most ambitious of Ilrusi Atoll
exploits to be committed to page in
scrupulous detail.

name: Anc. Beast Horn
description: The gnarled horn of a prehistoric beast, long since extinct.

name: Kukulkan's Skin
description: The exceptionally pliant and durable skin of Kukulkan. Ideal as a shock-absorbent lining for armor.

name: Briareus's Sash
description: A prized possession of the legendary Gigas, Briareus, unable to be severed by even the sharpest blade.

name: Regurg. Wing
description: This partially digested wing retrieved from a glavoid clearly did not agree with the giant worm's stomach.

name: Official Reflector
description:
This soul reflector has been approved
for use in all Pankration events. The
outline of a monster has been branded
onto the back of the reflector.

name: B. Puppet Turban
description:
This turban is for use on
Stormwaker-type automatons.
Enhances black magic skills.

name: W. Puppet Turban
description:
This turban is for use on
Stormwaker-type automatons.
Enhances white magic skills.

name: Almond
description:
Seeds of the almond tree
found in the Near East.

name: H. Qdv. Chestplate
description:
A durable chestplate worn by the
Quadav during battle. It is far too
bulky for people to wear.

name: H. Qdv. Backplate
description:
A durable shell worn by the Quadav
during battle. It is far too heavy for
people to wear.

name: Ladybug Wing
description:
This hard, shell-like wing bears
a unique red and black pattern.

name: Lycopodium Flower
description:
This bright red flower has been plucked
from the head of a lycopodium.

name: Gold Dust
description: 99.9% pure.

name: Slug Eye
description:
The remarkably elastic
eye stalk of a slug.

name: Orc Helmet
description:
A Goblin-made helmet worn by Orcs.
It is far too bulky for people to wear.

name: Orc Pauldron
description:
A Goblin-made shoulderpiece from
the armor of an Orc. It is far too
heavy for people to wear.

name: Lynx Hide
description: The colorful hide of a lynx.

name: Rafflesia Vine
description:
A vine cut from a carnivorous rafflesia.
The poisonous thorns aid the plant in
capturing prey.

name: Rafflesia Petal
description:
The fleshy petal of a carnivorous
rafflesia. The hook at its tip is used
to render prey immobile.

name: Sandworm Fang
description:
A serrated tooth taken from the maw
of a sandworm.

name: Sandworm Shell
description:
A chitinous plate that protects the
body of a sandworm.

name: Smilodon Hide
description: The striped hide of a smilodon.

name: Yagudo Osode
description:
A pauldron worn by the Yagudo. Its
awkward design makes it impossible for
people to wear.

name: Yagudo Kote
description:
A gauntlet worn by the Yagudo. Its
awkward design makes it impossible
for people to wear.

name: Gnole Claw
description:
The feculent claw of a gnole.
These talons are said to harbor
a score of infectious diseases.

name: Gnat Wing
description:
The light, yet pliable wing of
a giant gnat.

name: Peiste Skin
description: The elastic skin of a peiste.

name: Peiste Stinger
description:
A poisonous stinger found on the
head of a peiste.

name: Bottled Pixie
description:
Did you remember to
put holes in the lid?

name: Bkn. MMM Rod
description: Clearly of questionable durability from the start, this Moblin Maze Mongers fishing rod is now broken and unusable.

name: Red Oven Mitt
description:
Protects little Hume hands from hot
pots and pans.

name: Plume d'Or
description:
An attractive brooch comprised of
a gold feather and a single pearl.

name: Smildn. Leather
description: Hardy smilodon leather.

name: Lynx Leather
description: Light and durable lynx leather.

name: Obsidian
description:
This shiny, black volcanic glass
is often used in making weapons.

name: Teak Log
description: A rough-cut log of teak timber.

name: Teak Lumber
description: Processed teak lumber.

name: Jacaranda Log
description: A rough-cut log of jacaranda timber.

name: Jacaranda Lbr.
description: Processed jacaranda lumber.

name: Electrum Ingot
description: An ingot of smelted electrum.

name: Cilice
description:
Cloth woven from
wool and dhalmel hair.

name: Peiste Leather
description: Rough yet beautiful peiste leather.

name: Dhalmel Hair
description: The shiny, silken hair of a dhalmel.

name: Magellan Card
description:
A card created by the moogles for
the Starlight Celebration. When
opened, you can see twinkling stars.

name: Andromeda Card
description:
A card created by the moogles for
the Starlight Celebration. When
opened, you can see twinkling stars.

name: Goblin Mess Tin
description:
An all-purpose trencher forged from
darksteel. 7 out of 10 Goblins don't
leave home without one.

name: Goblin Weel
description:
A willow wicker basket used by
Goblins to catch fish and eels.

name: Smilodon Collar
description:
An large, leather collar studded with
sharp spikes.

name: Lynx Collar
description: A heavy collar made of gold.

name: Blk. Bolt Heads
description: The striking tips of black bolts.

name: Obsid. Arrowhd.
description: The striking tips of obsidian arrows.

name: Gnat Fletchings
description:
Gnat wings that are fitted to the nock
end of arrow shafts. They add to the
directional stability of arrows in flight.

name: Djinn Ash
description: The burnt remains of a djinn.

name: Vellum
description:
High-quality parchment made from
sheepskin. This particular piece
features a decorative border.

name: Electrum Chain
description: This chain is made of electrum links.

name: Campaign Voucher
description: A form of Op Credit endowing the holder with the right to participate in Campaign Ops. Issued by the Allied Forces high command.

name: Sanjaku-Tenugui
description:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Monomi."

name: Asphodel
description:
Known for its pungent aroma, this
yellow flower is known throughout
San d'Oria as the "Undying Lily."

name: Soshi
description:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Aisha."

name: Dnc. Testimony
description:
This papyrus scroll reads:
"The bearer of this document has
 proven excellence in the ways of
 the dancer."

name: Sch. Testimony
description:
This papyrus scroll reads:
"The bearer of this document has
 proven excellence in the ways of
 the scholar."

name: Yagudo Glue
description: A fine grained glue mixed by the Yagudo, used in the repair of pottery.

name: Bonanza Marble
description: A Mog Bonanza marble inscribed with the numbers which you have selected. Issued by the Mog House Management Union.

name: Fiend Plate
description:
An image captured while engaged in
surveillance of the Beastman
Confederate has been superimposed
onto this glass plate.

name: Pizza Dough
description: Excellent dough for making pizzas.

name: 108-Knot Quipu
description:
A knotted rope used by the Yagudo to
deliver orders. Due to the complexity and number of these knots, the encoded information is indecipherable.

name: Karugo Clay
description: An extremely high-quality, fine-grained clay originating in the vicinity of Fort Karugo-Narugo.

name: Peiste Pellets
description: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Peiste." A pungent, fish-like odor emanates from within.

name: Gnole Pellets
description: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Gnole." The familiar scent of blood emanates from within.

name: Gnat Pellets
description: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Gnat." The putrid stench of rot and decay emanates from within.

name: Dorter Key
description: A key to the former living quarters of low-ranking Yagudo initiates, converted to a prison after the outbreak of war.

name: Lthe. Consomme
description:
A light and refreshing vegetable soup
that draws on the harmonizing effects
of eastern ginger for its aroma and
flavor. Standard chocobo fodder.

name: Lethe Potage
description:
A thick and hearty vegetable soup that
draws on the harmonizing effects of
eastern ginger for its aroma and flavor.
Standard chocobo fodder.

name: Pelt of Dawon
description: The pelt of the legendary tigress Dawon, soft to the touch and beautifully patterned in fiery orange and black.

name: Balrahn's Eyepatch
description:
An eyepatch worn by the celebrated
hero of legend, Balrahn. It is regarded
as a sacred relic throughout the empire
of Aht Urhgan.

name: Pandemonium Key
description:
An elaborately fashioned and ornate
key used to gain passage through the
Pandemonium Gate.

name: Monkey Wine
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
hydra, Tinnin. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the three-headed
beast out of hiding.

name: Ferrite
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Armed Gears. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the robotic monstrosity
out of hiding.

name: Sheep Botfly
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Mamool Ja, Gotoh Zha the Redolent.
Allegedly irresistible enough to draw
the fiend out of hiding.

name: Olzhiryan Cactus
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
wivre, Dea. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the hulking beast out of hiding.

name: Senorita Pamama
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
marid, Iriz Ima. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the pugnacious
pachyderm out of hiding.

name: Oily Blood
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Lividroot Amooshah. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the dreaded
malboro matron out of hiding.

name: Samariri Corpsehair
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Poroggo, Iriri Samariri. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
nefarious amphibian out of hiding.

name: Hellcage Butterfly
description:
A known favorite of the notorious puk,
Vulpangue. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the plague-ridden pest out of
hiding.

name: Floral Nectar
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
colibri, Chamrosh. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the winged menace out
of hiding.

name: Rodent Cheese
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Qiqirn, Cheese Hoarder Gigiroon.
Allegedly irresistible enough to draw
the cheesy hedonist out of hiding.

name: Buffalo Corpse
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
cerberus, Sarameya. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
cantankerous canine out of hiding.

name: Pure Blood
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
vampyr, Nosferatu. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the perpetually
bloodlusting undead out of hiding.

name: Vinegar Pie
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Troll, Khromasoul Bhurborlor. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the gigantic
oaf out of hiding.

name: Rock Juice
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
wamoura, Achamoth. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
maneating moth out of hiding.

name: Raw Buffalo
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
dragon, Anantaboga. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
ferocious reptilian out of hiding.

name: Bone Charcoal
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
bomb, Reacton. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the enraged explosive
out of hiding.

name: Granulated Sugar
description:
A known favorite of the notorious flan,
Dextrose. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the gelatinous blob out of
hiding.

name: Shadeleaf
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
wamoura larva, Brass Borer. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
terrifying termite out of hiding.

name: Pectin
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
slime, Claret. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the blubbery mass out
of hiding.

name: Cog Lubricant
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
automaton, Ob. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the mechanical terror
out of hiding.

name: Singed Buffalo
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
khimaira, Tyger. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the mythic monster out
of hiding.

name: Exorcism Treatise
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
soulflayer, Mahjlaef the Paintorn.
Allegedly irresistible enough to draw
the merciless warlock out of hiding.

name: Myrrh
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
Experimental Lamia. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
serpentine witch out of hiding.

name: Rose Scampi
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
orobon, Nuhn. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the foul fish out of
hiding.

name: Opalus Gem
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
acrolith, Wulgaru. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the arcane atrocity out
of hiding.

name: M. No. 11 Molting
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
qutrub, Zareehkl the Jubilant. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
grotesque horror out of hiding.

name: Mint Drop
description:
A known favorite of the notorious imp,
Verdelet. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the evil sorcerer out of hiding.

name: Golden Teeth
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
skeleton, Velionis. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the bony ghoul out of
hiding.

name: Greenling
description:
A known favorite of the notorious Lil'
Apkallu. Allegedly irresistible enough to
draw the murderous avian out of hiding.

name: Spoilt Blood
description:
A known favorite of the notorious
chigoe, Chigre. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the bounding
bloodsucker out of hiding.

name: Coin of Birth
description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a sprouting seedling on the other.

name: Coin of Adv.
description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a rising sun on the other.

name: Coin of Glory
description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a rose in full bloom on the other.

name: Coin of Decay
description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a withered leaf on the other.

name: Coin of Ruin
description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a skull on the other.

name: Plat. Chestnut
description: An aromatic chestnut with a deep brown husk that grows in abundance on the lush grasslands of the La Theine Plateau. Rich in nutrients and quite tasty when roasted.

name: Tinnin's Fang
description:
The lethally toxic fang of the hydra,
Tinnin. It continues to drip poison from
the venom ducts within.

name: A. Gears' Fragment
description:
A mechanical fragment taken from the
disassembled remains of the menacing
Armed Gears. It appears to be a
generator designed for providing large
quantities of power.

name: G. Zha's Necklace
description:
Neckware of the Mamool Ja, Gotoh Zha
the Redolent. Forever imbued with the
indelible scent of its owner, it can be
equipped by none other.

name: Dea's Horn
description:
Taken from the nasal protrusion of
the massive wivre Dea, this imposing
horn is perfectly adapted for impaling
unwary targets.

name: Iriz Ima's Hide
description:
The thick, tough hide of Iriz Ima.
Its durability is a testament to its
capacity to protect the marid against
most forms of predation.

name: Amoosh.'s Tendril
description:
A wreathing, vinelike tendril amputated
from the malboro Lividroot Amooshah.
The meandering of the vine makes it
seem to continue to move, even in
death.

name: Iriri Samariri's Hat
description:
The perfectly form-fit hat of Poroggo 
Iriri Samariri. Tailor-made to an
amphibious head, it cannot and will not
adorn the typical adventurer noggin.

name: Vulpangue's Wing
description:
A wing clipping taken from the puk,
Vulpangue. Its lightness and thinness
belie both its strength and durability.

name: Chamrosh's Beak
description:
The razor-sharp beak of the colibri
Chamrosh, capable of easily tearing
apart the flesh of most any creature.

name: Gigiroon's Cape
description:
The cape and cowl of Qiqirn, Cheese
Hoarder Gigiroon. Fit to the unique
form of a Qiqirn body, it cannot be
donned by people, and reeks of
cheese.

name: Sarameya's Hide
description:
The tough, near-impenetrable hide of
Sarameya, one of the few known extant
members of the cerberus family.

name: Nosferatu's Claw
description:
Plunged into its victims and then
licked clean of the dripping blood,
this clawed appendage of the vampyr
Nosferatu still possesses a tangible
eeriness.

name: Bblr.'s Vambrace
description:
The solid and well-worn plate
armguard once donned by the Troll,
Khromasoul Bhurborlor. As with all troll
armor, it is far too cumbersome to be
worn by even the strongest of people.

name: Acham.'s Antenna
description:
An antenna taken from the fallen
wamoura, Achamoth. This tentacular
appendage is adept at detecting even
invisible and silent prey.

name: Anantaboga's Heart
description:
The enormous heart of the dragon,
Anantaboga. It is still saturated
through and through with foul reptilian
blood.

name: Reacton's Ashes
description:
The smoldering remains of the bomb,
Reacton. Despite the passage of time,
the cinders retain their immense heat.

name: Dextrose's Blubber
description:
The blubberous flesh of the flan,
Dextrose. It jiggles incessantly, even
when at rest.

name: B. Borer's Cocoon
description:
A cutting taken from the elaborate
cocoon spun by the larval wamoura,
Brass Borer.

name: Claret Globule
description:
A tiny blob of gelatinous flesh hacked
from the body of the slime, Claret.

name: Ob's Arm
description:
A technologically advanced automaton
arm, salvaged from the dismantled
remains of Ob.

name: Tyger's Tail
description:
Cleaved from the ferocious khimaira,
Tyger, this once lethal tail is wielded
in both whipping and stabbing motions.

name: Mahjlaef's Staff
description:
Too great in power and size to be
wielded by people, this wicked staff of
the soulflayer Mahjlaef the Paintorn is
no doubt responsible for the deaths of
countless adventurers.

name: Ex. Lamia Armband
description:
Decorative and protective armware of
Experimental Lamia. It inexplicably
resists being equipped on the arm of
any other.

name: Nuhn's Esca
description:
The bioluminescent, bulbous sac of
the oboron, Nuhn. The light is used to
attract unsuspecting prey in the dark
depths of cold waters.

name: Wulgaru's Head
description:
The severed head of the acrolith,
Wulgaru. It was once animated by a
most malicious arcane presence.

name: Zrkl.'s Neckpiece
description:
Necklace formerly worn by the qutrub,
Zareehkl the Jubilant. It is not
suited to dress the neck of any other individual.

name: Verdelet's Wing
description:
The detached, fleshy wing of the imp,
Verdelet. Either by some latent magic,
or simply remaining nerves, it twitches
periodically.

name: Velionis's Bone
description:
A shard of blackened bone taken from
the remains of the wicked skeleton,
Velionis.

name: Lil' Apkallu's Egg
description:
A shiny egg laid by Lil' Apkallu. The
pale green hue of the eggshell is an
unmistakable sign.

name: Chigre
description:
The complete and well-preserved
corpse of arguably the rarest member
of the chigoe family, Chigre.

name: Hardened Bone
description: This bone of indeterminate origin is hard enough to pass for solid rock. It would be highly difficult to craft.

name: Murex Spicule
description: A peculiar spiny protrusion removed from the curious creature known as a murex.

name: Amb. Pseudopod
description: A mass of some unidentifiable organic substance removed from the curious creature known as an amoeban.

name: Kabenro
description:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Myoshu."

name: Jinko
description:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Yurin."

name: Ryuno
description:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Kakka."

name: Eastern Ginger
description:
An eastern variety of ginger valued for
its sharp, refreshing aroma. Believed in
the East to possess divine powers of
protection, lending to its common
usage as a design motif in many coats
of arms.

name: Meta. Balsam
description:
A fragrant oil rumored to possess
aromas so potent they can alter the
very personalities of those who smell
them.

name: Meta. Perfume
description:
A fragrant perfume rumored to possess
aromas so potent they can alter the
very personalities of those who smell
them.

name: Ant. Arrowhd.
description: The striking tips of antlion arrows.

name: Colibri Fltchg.
description: Colibri feathers that are fitted to the nock end of arrow shafts. They add to the directional stability of arrows in flight.

name: Drk. Bolt Heads
description: The striking tips of darkling bolts.

name: Fsn. Bolt Heads
description: The striking tips of fusion bolts.

name: Gigas Helm
description:
The huge headwear of a full-grown
Gigas. Incapable of being equipped by
any other race, the helmet is designed
as much for inducing fear in the enemy
as protecting the head of its wearer.

name: Gigas Gauntlets
description:
The massive gauntlets worn by armored
Gigas. Far too large or heavy to be
worn by people, the lack of skill in
craftsmanship is compensated for by
sheer enormity and ruggedness.

name: Dark Ixion Horn
description:
The twisted and contorted horn
wrested from the head of Dark Ixion.
It emits an alluring yet lackluster shine
of foreboding blackness.

name: Dark Ixion Tail
description:
The plush, full tail of Dark Ixion.
Despite the ominous aura of evil still
surrounding the fine hairs, their innate
beauty is undeniable.

name: Luminian Thread
description:
A radiant silken thread spun
of the finest luminian filaments.

name: Flameshun Cloth
description:

description: The dagger-like fingernail of the fearsome vampyr Lord Ruthven, still specked with the blood of one of his unfortunate victims.

name: Krabkatoa Shell
description: The massive, still-smoldering shell of the gargantuan Krabkatoa, as solid and durable as a slab of volcanic rock.

name: Orcus Mandible
description: The imposing mandible of the mammoth antlion Orcus, suited to instantaneously crushing the life out of unwitting prey.

name: Mildewy Ingot
description: The excess mold growth on this shabby-looking ingot makes it impossible to discern what sort of metal it originally was.

name: Decayed Ingot
description: A decaying ingot of some indeterminate metal that feels as if it is about to crumble to dust in your hand.

name: Sanguinet
description: A translucent mass of tissue found protruding from the body of certain vorageans. Though slightly cracked, it retains a vivid scarlet hue.

name: Limule Pincer
description: The spiny pincer of a limule.

name: Clionid Wing
description: The delicate, translucent wing of a clionid.

name: Dried Chigoe
description: The withered husk of a dead chigoe.

name: R. Mutton Chop
description: This bloody slab of ram meat exudes an overpowering raw odor.

name: G. Blk. Tiger Fang
description: The oversized fang of a gargantuan species of black tiger.

name: Trophy Shield
description: A shield claimed by a Gigas off the body of a particularly renowned adventurer it slew.

name: Oversized Sock
description: This oversized sock of a Gigas reeks of blood and sweat. Far too large (and rancid) to be worn except by Gigas.

name: Massive Armband
description: A weighted armband used by Gigas in building their hulking muscles. Far too heavy to be worn except by Gigas.

name: Tr. Insect Wing
description: An insect wing so transparent as to be almost invisible to the eye.

name: Piceous Scale
description: A pitch-black scale that seems to smother the light around it.

name: Winter Puk Egg
description: Puk eggs laid in winter, such as this one, are said to be particularly rich in nutrients.

name: Bug-eaten Hat
description: This hole-ridden hat of a Poroggo appears to have provided a meal for many an insect. Only Poroggos can equip it.

name: Giant Agaricus
description: A particularly large and earthy agaricus mushroom.

name: Filthy Gnole Claw
description: This massive gnole claw is caked with dirt and grime.

name: Eft Blood
description: Blood from an eft, said to be so vile that even leeches steer clear of it.

name: G. Slug Eyestalk
description: The long, slimy eyestalk of a giant slug.

name: Moonglow Cloth
description: A gossamer astral fabric that glows only under the light of the moon. Far too delicate to use in crafting.

name: Rotting Eyeball
description: An eyeball from a treant that has begun to decompose.

name: Tiny Morbol Vine
description: A curiously small morbol vine.

name: Oblivispore
description: A poisonous fungus said to wipe clean the memory of any who eats it. Not suitable for consumption.

name: Snakeskin Moss
description: A curious mottled moss that had been growing from the back of a goobbue.

name: Arm. Dragonhorn
description: The massive horn of a wivre, of fearsome size and sharpness.

name: Ripped Eft Skin
description: A skin that appears to have been savagely ripped from the body of the eft it once belonged to.

name: Gt. Bugard Tusk
description: The particularly gargantuan tusk of a bugard.

name: Clouded Lens
description: A murky lens from the eye of an Ahriman.

name: Murmuring Glob
description: A small globule rumored to be the soul of a deep sea creature. Place it by your ear, and you can hear the sound of a murmuring stream...

name: H.Q. Cli. Wing
description: A particularly durable clionid wing.

name: H.Q. Lim. Pincer
description: A particularly sharp limule pincer.

name: Bl. Hecteye
description: The bloodshot eyeball of a hecteyes.

name: Baleful Skull
description: The cursed skull of a corpselight.

name: Bloody Fang
description: The fang of a bat, flecked with fresh blood.

name: Alkaline Humus
description: The strong alkaline concentration of this humus renders it highly unsuitable for gardening.

name: V. Scorp. Stinger
description: Still dripping with potent venom, this scorpion stinger must be handled with care.

name: Eft Egg
description: In spite of (or perhaps because of?) the slight sulphurous odor it exudes, eft eggs such as this one are considered a delicacy.

name: Ctrice. Tailmeat
description: Meat from the tail of a cockatrice. Stringy and flavorless, it is quite unpopular among culinarians.

name: Shk. Whisker
description: This whisker cut from the face of a coeurl pulsates with energy in your hand.

name: Resilient Mane
description: A particularly pliant and durable manticore mane.

name: Moaning Vestige
description: A fragment of some unidentifiable organic substance that emits a faint moaning sound.

name: Glavoid Shell
description: The massive shell of a glavoid.

name: 2Lf. Chloris Bud
description: An oversized flower from the crown of a chloris.

name: Helm of Briareus
description: An imposing helm that once guarded the head of the legendary Gigas Briareus. Only wearable by Gigas.

name: Carabosse's Gem
description: A small yet tasteful gem that belonged to the evil pixie queen Carabosse.

name: Fistl. Discharge
description: A thick, foul-smelling liquid expelled from a fistule.

name: Kukulkan's Fang
description: The massive fang of Kukulkan, capable of impaling a knight clean through his armor.

name: Chukwa's Egg
description: Laid by Chukwa, this egg is several orders of magnitude larger than a typical adamantoise egg.

name: Manan. Necklet
description: The oversized necklet of a manananggal. An incantation of warding prevents any but its original owner from equipping it.

name: Marvin's Pelage
description: The ratty, flea-ridden pelage of Mangy-tailed Marvin.

name: Chasmic Stinger
description: A dagger-like stinger harvested from the body of a chasmic hornet.

name: Raskovnik Vine
description: The giant vine of a raskovnik.

name: Bakka's Wing
description: A wing clipped from the imp lord Bakka.

name: Cuelebre's Horn
description: The fearsome horn of the legendary serpent Cuelebre.

name: Mictlan. Habit
description: The dark robes worn by the necromancer Mictlantecuhtli while performing his dark rituals. Not wearable by living beings.

name: Keesha Pamama
description: A pamama purloined from the possession of the fruit-fancying Keesha Poppo.

name: Mikey's Nugget
description: A hefty silver nugget removed from the stomach of Megamaw Mikey. Likely the cause of a mega-serious case of indigestion.

name: Balaur Skull
description: The ghastly skull of a balaur wyvern.

name: Lieje Lantern
description: Once carried by a Tonberry Lieje, this lantern still burns with an ominous, hateful light.

name: Shriveled Wing
description: The wing of a clionid, now shriveled from excess exposure to the air.

name: Tarnished Pincer
description: The pincer of a limule, now tarnished from excess exposure to the air.

name: Exorcised Skull
description: This corpselight skull has been cleansed of the curse that once resided in it.

name: Acidic Humus
description: Mildly acidic in composition, this humus is well suited for gardening.

name: Quiv. Eft Egg
description: This eft egg seems about to hatch at any moment...

name: Smooth Whisker

name: Malachite

name: M. Counteragent
description: A gaseous substance that acts to temporarily disperse miasmas.

name: Viscous Spittle

name: Powder Casket
description: A small casket of gunpowder. Dampened from time spent underwater, it is likely unusable in its current state.

name: Kindred's Crest

name: H. Kindred Crest

name: S. Kindred Crest

name: Kupon W-E85

A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for level 85 empyrean weapons.

name: Kupon A-RJob

A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).

name: Water Lily

name: Sanguine Spike

name: Ulhuadshi's Fang

name: Sobek's Skin

name: Cirein. Lantern

name: Bukhis's Wing

name: Sedna's Tusk

name: Daybreak Soul

name: Twilight Soul

description: A plate of some indeterminate metal, retrieved from a deactivated spheroid.

name: Hd. Raptor Skin
description: The frozen, hardened skin of a raptor.

name: Mocking Beak
description: The beak of a colibri said to have the ability to mimic adventurers' voices.

name: H.Q. Crab Meat
description: This piece of land crab meat is of perfect quality. So perfect, in fact, that it would be unthinkable to eat it.

name: H.Q. Rock Salt
description: A chunk of rock salt of the highest grade and quality.

name: Worm-Eaten Bud
description: This hole-ridden mandragora bud has clearly served as a feast for many a famished worm.

name: Spotted Flyfrond
description: An attractive spotted pattern adorns this giant flytrap leaf.

name: Blk. Rabbit Tail
description: The tail of a black rabbit, said to serve as a warding talisman.

name: Gnr. Taurus Horn
description: The balefully gnarled horn of a taurus.

name: Gargouille Stone
description: A hunk of flesh from a gargouille that has hardened to the point that it is indistinguishable from actual stone.

name: Moonbeam Clam
description: A rare clam said to open its shell only when the light of the moon shines upon it.

name: Dented Skull
description: The skull of a corpselight that seems to have caught a hefty blow to its head.

name: Stiff. Tentacle
description: This tentacle has stiffened after the death of the soulflayer it was once attached to.

name: Black Whisker
description: Other than its jet-black color, this feline whisker is entirely unremarkable.

name: Opaque Wing
description: The murky-colored wing of some unnatural beast.

name: Fortune Wing
description: This red wing of a ladybug is said to bring good luck to he who finds it.

name: Djinn Ashes
description: The smoldering ashes of a now-extinguished djinn.

name: Shockshroom
description: A poisonous mushroom said to send a paralyzing shock through the body if consumed.

name: Crwl. Floatstone
description: A small stone removed from the stomach of a crawler. Can be used as pumice.

name: H.Q. Rabbit Hide
description: The particularly sturdy hide of a rabbit.

name: Rvg. Seal: Hd.
description: A musty slip of parchment, worn and faded with the years. Faintly visible is the image of a piece of armor, annotated with elaborately scribed glyphs of a long-lost tongue.

name: Vision Stone
description: A peculiar translucent stone that refracts light, making objects seen through it appear bright and clear.

name: Vision Coin
description: A palm-sized coin of a curious transparent metal.

name: Vision Jewel
description: A shimmering jewel of perfect cut and clarity.

name: Vision Card
description: A timeworn card bearing an exquisitely illustrated depiction of a far-seeing eye.

name: Ardor Stone
description: Holding this small crimson stone in your hand, you feel a gentle warmth well up from within you.

name: Ardor Coin
description: A palm-sized coin embossed with the mark of a burning heart.

name: Ardor Jewel
description: The red hues of this jewel blaze and surge like the flames of passion.

name: Ardor Card
description: A timeworn card bearing an exquisite illustration of a raging flame.

name: Wieldance Stone
description: Taking this stone into hand, you can feel your arm move more freely.

name: Wieldance Coin
description: A palm-sized coin emblazoned with the mark of a hand gripping a blade.

name: Wieldance Jewel
description: The amber hues of this jewel swish and swirl unconstrained.

name: Wieldance Card
description: A timeworn card bearing an exquisite illustration of a whirling sword.

name: Balance Stone
description: A sturdy stone that, when placed on the ground, can curiously not be moved from either side.

name: Balance Coin
description: A peculiar coin that, when flipped, will always alternate heads and tails.

name: Balance Jewel
description: A beautiful translucent jewel of perfectly symmetrical cut.

name: Balance Card
description: A timeworn card bearing an exquisitely illustrated depiction of a weighing scale.

name: Voyage Stone
description: Taking this stone into hand, you can feel the wind blowing at your back.

name: Voyage Coin
description: A palm-sized coin embossed with the mark of a ship with billowing sails.

name: Voyage Jewel
description: The blue hues of this jewel ebb and flow like the ocean tides.

name: Voyage Card
description: A timeworn card bearing an exquisitely illustrated depiction of a striding man.

name: Tablilla Mercury
description: A shimmering liquid metal extracted from the doll Tablilla.

name: Sharabha Hide
description: The rugged hide of the manticore Sharabha.

name: Tiger King Hide
description: The regally colored hide of the fell tiger Ansherekh.

name: Vadleany Fluid
description: A pungent liquid extracted from a slain vadleany, its role of driving away would-be foes unfulfilled.

name: Oasis Water
description: A precious bottle of pure water from a desert oasis, carried by the fearsome Bugul Noz.

name: Sandy Shard
description: Desert sand clings to the surface of this shattered doll fragment.

name: Smoldering Arm
description: This arm of a bomb still steams and smolders despite having been long since severed from its master.

name: Sand-caked Fang
description: This oversized manticore fang is caked with such a thick layer of sand that its original shape and color is impossible to discern.

name: H.Q. Dhalmel Hide
description: A particularly durable dhalmel hide.

name: Puppet's Blood
description: The blood of an unnaturally bred puk, said to impel anyone who drinks it to dance uncontrollably.

name: H.Q. Cktrice. Skin
description: A particularly durable cockatrice skin.

name: Ladybird Leaf
description: A broad, thick-veined leaf that had been stuck to the back of an unaware ladybug.

name: H.Q. Scorpn. Claw
description: A particularly sharp scorpion claw.

name: Sabulous Clay
description: A variety of desert clay with a high sand content.

name: Giant Mistletoe
description: A parasitic plant so tenacious that it is known to strangle the life out of even the mightiest oaks.

name: Bevel Gear
description: A massive, jagged-toothed gear of bronze that powered the mighty Koghatu.

name: Snow God Core
description: This condensed soul of the fearsome Upas-Kamuy burns with a chill blue flame.

name: Sisyphus Fragment
description: A fragment of debris claimed off the shattered body of the golem Sisyphus.

name: Rimed Wing
description: The frost-covered wing of the notorious imp Chillwing Hwitti.

name: Audumbla Hide
description: The rough hide of the bovine audumbla.

name: Helical Gear
description: A curved metallic gear that once powered a mighty acrolith.

name: Gear Fluid
description: A peculiar, oil-like substance that will not freeze in even the coldest temperatures.

name: Gelid Arm
description: The arm of a snoll, so stingingly cold that holding it in one's bare hand will inflict an almost instant case of frostbite.

name: H.Q. Marid Hide
description: A particularly durable marid hide.

name: Ice Wyvern Scale
description: This wyvern scale is as chill as ice to the touch.

name: Whiteworm Clay
description: A rich clay-like substance excreted from the body of an entozoon.

name: Imp Sentry's Horn
description: A compact horn employed by imp sentries to warn their masters of potential interlopers.

name: Benumbed Eye
description: This clouded eye of a benumbed vodoriga stares at you with a soulless, empty gaze.

name: H.Q. Buffalo Horn
description: A particularly large and sturdy buffalo horn.

name: H.Q. B. Tiger Hide
description: The particularly rugged and sleek hide of a black tiger.

name: Teekess. Fragment
description: The shattered fragment of the Teekesselchen.

name: Minaruja Skull
description: The abnormally hard skull of the wyvern Minaruja.

name: Jaculus Wing
description: The almost-weightless yet highly durable wing of the peapuk Jaculus.

name: Naiad's Lock
description: A wispy lock of hair from the pixie Lorelei, whose haunting song is said to have beckoned many an adventurer to an untimely demise.

name: Goblin Gunpowder
description: A highly explosive gunpowder devised by the mad Goblin bombardier Burstrox Powderpate.

name: Bubbling Oil
description: Extracted from a magic pot, the noxious fumes of this thick oil induce nausea with a single whiff.

name: Darkflame Arm
description: Severed from an unfortunate djinn, this arm blazes with a black, heatless flame.

name: Pursuer's Wing
description: The wing of the ajattara wyvern, said to chase away evil spirits of the forest.

name: H.Q. Wivre Hide

name: D. Oro. Steak

name: Airlixir
description: This mystical and magical solution may be as intangible as the air itself, but it still draws out immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

name: Airlixir +1
description: This mystical and magical solution may be as intangible as the air itself, but it still draws out immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

name: Airlixir +2
description: This mystical and magical solution may be as intangible as the air itself, but it still draws out immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

name: Gabbrath Horn
description: The mafic horn of a culled gabbrath that remains doused in the blood of the countless pioneers unfortunate enough to be impaled upon it.

name: Rockfin Fin
description: A rigid dorsal fin with a surprisingly clean and soft shape. It once belonged to a rockfin before the beast was fished up from the depths of the unknown.

name: Rockfin Tooth
description: Sharper than the most finely whetted blade, this rockfin tooth can slice through an unwary pioneer's fingers in an instant.

name: Bztavian Stinger
description: Once attached to the abdomen of an enraged bztavian, this stinger would make even the winds retreat in fear when thrust.

name: Bztavian Wing
description: This wing ripped forcefully from the back of a bztavian would cause roaring gales to erupt whenever flapped.

name: Arborscent Seed
description: That this seed will produce vegetation is known. Where the seed came from, however, is not.

name: Arborfruit Seed
description: That this seed will spring forth fruit is known. Where the seed came from, however, is not.

name: G. Seed Pouch
description: A pouch containing the seeds of a golden yellow flower.

name: M. Beetle Saliva
description: Viscous, noxious drool scraped from the mouth of a massive insect that slobbers uncontrollably. Slathering it on mineral veins attracts antlions.

name: Ch. Tree Sap
description: A fragrant fluid that releases an odor many insects crave. Placing it in an arboreal grove makes it possible to harvest beetles occasionally.

name: Garden Worm
description:
A long and lithe slimy slitherer that enriches the soil wherever it tunnels.
Increases the yield of crops from a furrow.

name: Grove Humus
description:
This humus apparently has no official origin, as scholars have yet to ascertain its native habitat.
Reduces the length of a furrow's grow season.

name: Coalition Humus
description: This spectacular example of humus was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades. Occasionally produces strange and wondrous harvests.

name: Grove Worm
description:
A long and lithe slimy slitherer that enriches the soil wherever it tunnels.
Increases the bounty obtained from a grove.

name: Grove Mulch
description:
This specialized mulch works even in the unforgiving Ulbukan soil, keeping the trees growing straight and strong.
Occasionally increases the number of times one can log a grove.

name: Grove Cuttings
description:
Cuttings from trees nestled in an unspecified forest somewhere in Vana'diel.
Enables lumber to be more easily procured from groves.

name: Entisyrup
description:
This thick and viscous nectar emits an aroma so enticing that many pioneers begin to slaver simply at the thought of tasting it.
Allows insects to be more easily procured from groves.

name: Coalit. Fertilizer
description:
This spectacular example of fertilizer was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous finds to flourish in a grove.

name: Stone Serum
description:
A solution that magically softens the surface of mineral veins and primes them for mining.
Increases the yield of a vein when mined.

name: Vein Serum
description:
A solution that magically stiffens the surface of mineral veins, which keeps them from degrading quickly.
Occasionally increases the number of times a vein can be mined.

name: Auserum
description:
A solution that transmogrifies the surface of mineral veins, completely changing their composition.
Allows for precious metals to be more easily procured while mining.

name: Smelting Serum
description:
A solution that transmogrifies the surface of mineral veins, completely changing their composition.
Allows for metals to be more easily procured while mining.

name: Coalition Serum
description:
This spectacular example of a serum was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous finds to flourish when mining.

name: Sardine Sphere
description: A ball of ground sardine mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

name: Bass Sphere
description: A ball of ground bass mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

name: Shrimp Sphere
description: A ball of ground shrimp mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

name: Baitball
description: A ball of ground mincemeat mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

name: Super Baitball
description:
This spectacular example of rolled bait was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous catches when fishing in freshwater.

name: Sardine Chum
description: A sack of mangled sardine mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

name: Bass Chum
description: A sack of mangled bass mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

name: Shrimp Chum
description: A sack of mangled shrimp mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

name: Mincemeat Chum
description: A sack of mincemeat slapped together and mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

name: Coalition Chum
description:
This spectacular example of chum was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous catches when fishing in saltwater.

name: Grow-M-Good
description:
This spectacular example of a catalytic enzyme was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Makes crops harvestable in almost no time.

name: Waktza Rostrum
description: Though this beak was already torn violently from the head of a conquered waktza, lightning still crackles and darts around it, temporarily paralyzing any who dare to touch its dagger-blade surface.

name: Waktza Crest
description: Once crowning the head of a proud waktza, this delicately soft feather belies the ferocity of its former master. Due to its difficulty to obtain, many fortunate enough to get their hands upon one employ it as a good luck charm.

name: Yggdreant Bole
description: This sturdy trunk hacked free of a yggdreant after a flurry of agonizing attempts puts the fear of the forest into each and every pioneer who dares steal even a glimpse at it.

name: Yggdreant Root
description: This knotted and gnarled root, chopped from the base of a fallen yggdreant, is rumored to bestow everlasting life upon those who boil it in their tea.

name: Tulfaire Feather
description: A tulfaire pinion feather.

name: Mand. Sprout
description: The verdant, two-leafed shoot that emerges from the heads of all mandragoras. Contemporary researchers proffer that its leaves capture sunlight and convert it into a sort of nourishment.

name: Guatambu Log
description: A rough-cut log of guatambu timber.

name: Gua. Lumber
description: Processed guatambu lumber.

description: Snowsteel forged into a sheet.

A grass common throughout the Ulbukan continent.
Fiber taken from its stem is used as
a material for akaso thread.

name: Akaso Thread

name: Akaso Cloth
description: Cloth woven from akaso fiber thread.

name: Runeweave
description: This jet-black cloth contains the faintest remains of runic sorcery woven into its fabric.

name: Sekishitsu
description: Originating from a country in the Far East, this blood red and pitch black coating, made from the sap of the lacquer tree, is often used on wooden crafts.

name: Snap. Secretion
description: The digestive juices that rest inside a snapweed's mouth and trap whatever prey is unfortunate enough to wander inside.

name: Snap. Tendril
description: The still-twitching and vine-like limb of a snapweed.

name: Lavarion
description: A resplendent jewel streaked with slowly snaking lines of magma.

name: Atramenterrane
description: Its inky slick appearance and metallic lustre are but two clues to the subterranean powers this rock harbors, such as mitigating the forces of water.

name: Cyclone Cotton
description: Forcefully shorn from its stem by tempestuous winds that churn with the power of the heavens, this bulb of cotton came from locales unknown.

name: Corroded Ore

name: Rem's Tale Ch.1
description: The first chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. The kingdom is fraught with chaos, as a long-ruling king collapses. His death engenders a terrible power struggle, from which Rem miraculously emerges the victor.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.2
description: The second chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the leader of a neighboring empire takes advantage of Rem's inexperience and invades his homeland.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.3
description: The third chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, Rem's kingdom is unceremoniously routed by the invaders and annexed to their territory.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.4
description: The fourth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, Rem is stripped of his crown and imprisoned within his own palace's oubliette.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.5
description: The fifth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the protagonist struggles to maintain his sanity while locked in what is ostensibly a granite-lined hole for a full decade.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.6
description: The sixth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, a rowdy band of vagabonds who long for the good old days of Rem's rule slips into the oubliette under the cover of darkness and saves him in his eleventh year of imprisonment.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.7
description: The seventh chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, news of Rem's rescue rings throughout the land and galvanizes the masses to stand up in resistance to the neighboring tyrant.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.8
description: The eighth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the hefty number of resistance fighters rise up against their oppressive foreign king.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.9
description: The ninth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the resistance movement succeeds against all odds. The well-trained phalanxes of infantry from the neighboring kingdom lie battered and defeated outside the castle gates.

name: Rem's Tale Ch.10
description: The final chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the crown is returned to Rem thirteen years after the whole ordeal began. Everyone lives happily ever after under his fair and just rule.

name: Cavorting Worm
description: A worm that wiggles and flourishes so joyfully that it almost seems to be smiling.

name: Titanic Sawfish
description:
Feared by sailors and pirates alike,
this giant sea monster has been known
to tear apart ships with its razor-sharp
teeth.

name: Moorish Idol
description:
This tropical fish makes its home
among the coral of the Maliyakaleya
Reef. The Tarutaru love to keep them
as pets.

name: Bibiki Slug
description:
This echinoderm is found all over
Bibiki Bay. While edible, you will
not find any gracing the menu
of a four-star restaurant.

name: Jacknife
description:
This bivalve shellfish lives in the
sands of Bibiki Bay. It scares away
predators by shooting out of its
shell like a rocket.

name: Tropical Clam
description:
This bivalve shellfish lives in the
sands of Bibiki Bay. Recently, excess
gathering has led to a decline in their
numbers.

name: Phanauet Newt
description:
This green amphibian is found only in
the Phanauet Channel.

name: Muddy Siredon
description:
A tiny newt is found only in the
Phanauet Channel. It is easily
recognizable by its large outer gills.

name: Gugrusaurus
description:
A mythical reptile said to roam the
seven seas.

name: Cone Calamary
description:
This variety of squid is known for its
cone-shaped body.

name: Lik
description:
A fabled freshwater fish, legendary for
its enormous length.

name: Tavnazian Goby
description:
A freshwater fish found in the rivers
of the Tavnazian Archipelago. It is
easily recognized by its orange and
silver stripes.

name: Vongola Clam
description:
This bivalve shellfish found in the
waters around Purgonorgo Isle is
known for its exquisite flavor.

name: Gurnard
description:
This saltwater fish lives in the
Gugru Blue.
It can fly in the air, but only for
a short time.

name: Pterygotus
description:
This giant arthropod is also known as
a "sea scorpion."

name: Mola Mola
description:
Legends say that this enormous
saltwater fish has rescued shipwreck
victims at sea.

name: Rhinochimera
description:
This enormous saltwater fish has a
swordlike tusk growing from its head.

name: Istavrit
description:
This saltwater fish inhabits the reefs
of the Arrapago Islands.
Its fins are extremely poisonous.

name: Turnabaligi
description:
This enormous freshwater fish
sometimes preys on waterbirds and
unsuspecting beasts that venture
too close to the water's edge.

name: Black Ghost
description:
This freshwater fish gives off light
from inside its body.

name: Betta
description:
This beautifully colored fish possesses
a strong fighting instinct.
People often raise bettas to watch
them fight or simply for viewing.

name: Kalkanbaligi
description:
This legendary giant saltwater fish is
also referred to as a "Gigas's Shield."

name: Veydal Wrasse
description:
This enormous saltwater fish is named
after a legendary admiral.

description: The colder the water, the more this fish thrives, for it can only be found in rivers and lakes in Ulbuka that have been frozen over.
